translations.literal: Food and Goods, Part Six of the Upper Scroll
translations.idiomatic: Food and Goods, Upper Scroll, Part Six

translations.literal: (Service Law, Lower Section: Relief and Succor)
translations.idiomatic: (Service Law, Lower Section: Relief and Succor)

sentences.zh: 役法

translations.literal: Service Law
translations.idiomatic: Service Law

sentences.zh: 中書舍人蘇軾在詳定役法所，極言役法可雇不可差，第不當於雇役實費之外，多取民錢，若量入為出，不至多取，則自足以利民。

translations.literal: Su Shi, Secretariat Drafter, was at the Office for Detailed Determination of the Service Law and spoke at length that the service law could employ but could not assign by rotation; only one ought not beyond the actual costs of hired service take more money from the people—if measuring income to set expenditure and not taking excessively, then of itself it would suffice to benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: Su Shi, a Secretariat drafter serving on the commission to finalize the service law, argued forcefully that corvée should be met by hiring laborers rather than by rotational assignment. His only objection was that the state should not collect more from the people than the actual cost of hired service. If revenues were measured against outlays and no surplus were taken, the system would benefit the people on its own.

sentences.zh: 司馬光不然之，光言：“差役已行，續聞有命：雇募不足，方許定差。

translations.literal: Sima Guang did not agree. Guang said: "Rotational assignment of service duties had already been implemented, and it was subsequently heard that there was an order: only when hired recruitment was insufficient might fixed rotational assignment be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang disagreed. He said, "Rotational assignment was already in effect, and we then heard a further order: only when hired recruitment proved inadequate might fixed rotational assignment be allowed.

sentences.zh: 屢有更張，號令不一。

translations.literal: Repeatedly there were changes and revisions; orders and commands were not uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Orders were changed again and again, and the commands no longer matched one another.

sentences.zh: 又轉運使欲合一路共為一法，不令州縣各從其宜，或已受差卻釋役使去，或已辭雇卻復拘之入役，或仍舊用錢招雇，或不用錢白招，紛紜不定，浸違本意。”

translations.literal: Moreover, transport commissioners wished to unite an entire circuit into one law, not allowing prefectures and counties each to follow what was suitable. Some who had already received rotational assignment were released from service and sent away; some who had already declined hiring were again compelled and bound into service; some still used money to recruit hires; some recruited without money for nothing—confused and unsettled, gradually violating the original intent.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioners also wanted a single law for an entire circuit instead of letting each prefecture and county adapt the rules locally. Some men already assigned by rotation were released; some who had refused hiring were forced back into service; some circuits still paid to recruit laborers while others recruited without pay. The result was chaos that steadily betrayed the policy's original purpose.

sentences.zh: 遂條舉始奏之文，嚐許州縣、監司陳列宜否。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark He then itemized the text of the initial memorial and once permitted prefectures, counties, and supervisory officials to set forth what was suitable or not.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark He then cited the provisions of the original memorial and restored the permission once granted for prefectures, counties, and supervisory officials to report what worked and what did not.

sentences.zh: “自今外官苟見利否，縣許直上轉運司，州許直奏，使下情無壅。

translations.literal: "From now on, if outside officials see benefit or harm, counties are permitted to report directly upward to the transport commission, and prefectures are permitted to memorialize directly, so that sentiments from below are not blocked.
translations.idiomatic: "Henceforth, whenever local officials outside the capital see benefit or harm in the law, counties may report straight to the transport commission and prefectures may memorialize the throne directly, so that grievances from below are not blocked.

sentences.zh: 詳定所第當稽閱監司、州縣所陳，詳定可否；

translations.literal: The detailed-determination office should only examine and review what supervisory officials and prefectures and counties submit and determine what is feasible or not;
translations.idiomatic: The review commission should examine what supervisory officials and local governments submit and decide what is feasible;

sentences.zh: 非其任職而務出奇論、不切事情者勿用，亦不可以一路、一州、一縣土風利害概行天下。”

translations.literal: those not in their proper posts who strive for startling opinions and do not fit the facts of the matter should not be employed, and likewise one cannot take the local customs, benefits, and harms of one circuit, one prefecture, or one county and apply them universally throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: opinions from men outside their proper duties who seek novelty without regard to facts should be rejected; nor may the customs and interests of one circuit, prefecture, or county be imposed on the entire empire.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark The court followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark The court approved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，詔：“諸路坊郭五等以上，及單丁、女戶、官戶、寺觀第三等以上，舊輸免役錢者並減五分，餘戶等下此者悉免輸，仍自元祐二年始。

translations.literal: Before long, an edict stated: "In all circuits, urban households of the fifth rank and above, as well as single-male households, female-headed households, official households, and monasteries and temples of the third rank and above that formerly paid exemption-from-service money shall all have a reduction of five-tenths; the remaining household ranks below this are entirely exempted from payment, effective from the second year of Yuanyou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward an edict declared: "In every circuit, urban households of the fifth rank and above, together with single-male households, female-headed households, official households, and monasteries rated third rank or higher that formerly paid exemption money shall all receive a fifty-percent reduction. All lower ranks are fully exempt, effective from the second year of Yuanyou.

sentences.zh: 凡支酬衙前重難及綱運公皂迓送飧錢，用坊場、河渡錢給賦。

translations.literal: All payments for yamen-runners' heavy and difficult duties and for transport-corps, clerks, and escort meal money shall use market-stand and ferry-crossing funds for disbursement.
translations.idiomatic: All payments for yamen-runners' hazardous duties, transport-corps service, clerks, and escort allowances shall come from market-stand and ferry revenues.

sentences.zh: 不足，方得於此六色錢助用；

translations.literal: If insufficient, only then may the six categories of money be used to assist;
translations.idiomatic: Only if those revenues prove insufficient may the six categories of service funds be drawn upon;

sentences.zh: 而有餘，封樁以備不時之須。”

translations.literal: if there is a surplus, it shall be sealed and stored to prepare for unforeseen needs.
translations.idiomatic: any surplus shall be sealed in reserve for emergencies.

sentences.zh: 臣僚上言：“朝廷雖立差法，而明許民戶雇代，州縣多已施行。

translations.literal: Court officials submitted: "Although the court established the rotational-assignment law, it clearly permitted common households to hire substitutes, and prefectures and counties had largely already implemented this.
translations.idiomatic: Officials memorialized: "Although the court established rotational assignment, it clearly allowed households to hire substitutes, and most prefectures and counties had already put this into practice.

sentences.zh: 近命弓手須正身，恐公私未便。”

translations.literal: The recent order that bowmen must serve in person may, we fear, be inconvenient for public and private interests alike.
translations.idiomatic: The recent order requiring bowmen to serve in person may prove inconvenient for both government and populace.

sentences.zh: 詔：“不願身自任役，許募嚐為弓手而有勞效者，雇直雖多，毋逾元募之數。”

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark An edict stated: "Those unwilling to bear service in person are permitted to recruit men who have once served as bowmen and shown meritorious performance; although hire wages may be high, they must not exceed the original recruitment amount."
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark The throne replied: "Households unwilling to serve in person may hire men who have previously served as bowmen with proven merit. Although wages may be high, they must not exceed the original recruitment rate."

sentences.zh: 御史中丞劉摯言：“弓手不可不用差法者，蓋鄉人在役，則不獨有家丁子弟之助，至於族姻鄉黨，莫不與為耳目，有捕輒獲；

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhi said: "Bowmen must use the rotational-assignment law, for when fellow townsmen are on duty, they do not only have the help of household retainers and sons and younger brothers; as for clan kin and township associates, none fail to serve as eyes and ears—with capture, they are seized at once;
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhi argued: "Bowmen must be assigned by rotation. When a local man serves, he has not only his household retainers and sons to help him; kinsmen and neighbors all serve as his eyes and ears, and arrests follow swiftly.

sentences.zh: 又土著自重，無逃亡之患。

translations.literal: Moreover, as natives rooted in the soil they value themselves and have no worry of flight.
translations.idiomatic: As natives bound to their home soil, they value their standing and do not flee.

sentences.zh: 自行雇募，盜寇充斥，蓋浮惰不能任責故也。

translations.literal: Since hiring and recruitment on their own began, bandits have filled the land—this is because the floating and indolent cannot bear responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Since hiring was allowed, banditry has spread, because drifters and idlers cannot bear real responsibility.

sentences.zh: 如五路弓手，熙寧未變法前，身自執役，最號強勁，其材藝捕緝勝於他路。

translations.literal: For example, bowmen of the Five Circuits before the Xining reforms, serving in person, were most renowned as strong and vigorous; their skill in arrest and pursuit surpassed other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the Five Circuits, before the Xining reforms bowmen served in person and were famed as the toughest; their skill at pursuit and arrest surpassed every other region.

sentences.zh: 近日復差，不聞有不樂而願出錢雇人。

translations.literal: Recently, with rotational assignment restored, one has not heard of those unwilling who wished to pay money to hire others.
translations.idiomatic: Since rotational assignment was restored, no one has complained or offered money to hire a substitute.

sentences.zh: 惟是川蜀、江、浙等路，昨升差上一等戶，皆習於驕脆，不肯任察捕之責。

translations.literal: Only in circuits such as Sichuan-Shu, the Yangzi region, and Jiang-Zhe, where households promoted one rank higher for assignment were all accustomed to pride and softness, they were unwilling to bear the responsibility of patrol and arrest.
translations.idiomatic: Only in Sichuan, the Yangzi delta, and the southeast, where households promoted one rank for assignment had grown soft and proud, were men unwilling to bear patrol and arrest duties.

sentences.zh: 欲乞五路必差正身，餘路即用新敕，厘為三色：舊有戶等已嚐受差者，曾有戰鬥勞效應留者，願雇人代己者。

translations.literal: We wish to request that the Five Circuits must assign the person in the flesh; the remaining circuits should immediately use the new edict and divide into three categories: old household ranks that have once received rotational assignment; those who should remain because they once had combat merit; and those willing to hire men to replace themselves.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the Five Circuits require service in person, while other circuits follow the new edict and divide households into three groups: those previously assigned by rotation; those with proven combat merit who should remain; and those willing to hire substitutes.

sentences.zh: 立此三色，所冀新舊相兼，漸習禦捕。”

translations.literal: Establishing these three categories, what is hoped is that new and old will be combined and that gradually they will become practiced in defense and arrest.
translations.idiomatic: With these three categories, old and new methods may blend until men gradually master patrol and arrest.

sentences.zh: 侍御史王岩叟亦言雇代恐不能任事，略與摯同。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Attending Censor Wang Yansou also said that hired substitutes probably could not bear the duties, broadly agreeing with Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark Attending Censor Wang Yansou likewise warned that hired substitutes might not perform their duties, largely agreeing with Liu Zhi.

sentences.zh: 監察御史上官均言：“役之最重，莫如衙前，其次弓手。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Shangguan Jun said: "Of service duties, none is heavier than yamen-runner; next is bowman.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Shangguan Jun said: "Of all corvée duties, none weighs heavier than yamen-runner service; bowman duty comes next.

sentences.zh: 今東南長名衙前招募既足，所差不及上戶，上戶必差弓手，則是以上戶就中戶之役，實為優幸。

translations.literal: Now in the southeast, long-term yamen-runner recruitment is already full, so rotational assignments do not reach upper households; upper households must be assigned as bowmen—this is upper households taking middle households' service, which is in truth a privilege.
translations.idiomatic: In the southeast, permanent yamen-runner posts are already filled by recruitment, so rotational duty no longer reaches upper households. Upper households are therefore assigned as bowmen—taking middle-household duties instead. This is a real privilege for the wealthy.

sentences.zh: 上戶產厚而役輕，下戶產薄而無役，然則所當補恤，正在中戶。

translations.literal: Upper households have thick property but light service; lower households have thin property and no service—thus what ought to receive relief lies precisely with middle households.
translations.idiomatic: The wealthy hold large estates yet bear light duties; the poor hold little and bear none. Relief should therefore target middle households.

sentences.zh: 今若增上戶役年，使中戶番休稍久，則補除相均矣。”

translations.literal: If now upper households' years of service are increased so that middle households' rotational rest is somewhat longer, then compensation and exemption would be balanced.
translations.idiomatic: If upper households served longer terms so middle households could rest longer between rotations, the burden would balance fairly.

sentences.zh: 又言：“近許當差弓手戶役得雇人為代，此法最便。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark He also said: "Recently permitting households assigned as bowmen to hire men as substitutes—this method is most convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark He added: "The recent permission for assigned bowmen to hire substitutes is the most practical rule.

sentences.zh: 議者謂‘身任其役，則自愛而重犯法’，熙寧募法久行，何嚐聞盜賊充斥？

translations.literal: Critics say, 'If one bears service in person, then one cherishes oneself and heavily fears violating the law.' The Xining recruitment law was long in force—when did one ever hear of bandits filling the land?
translations.idiomatic: Critics claim that men serving in person cherish their reputations and fear breaking the law. Yet under the long-standing Xining recruitment system, when was banditry ever rampant?

sentences.zh: 彼自愛之民，承符帖追逮則可，俾之與賊角死，豈其能哉？

translations.literal: Those self-cherishing commoners can accept warrants and pursue and arrest, but to make them grapple with bandits unto death—how could they?
translations.idiomatic: Such self-regarding men can serve warrants and make arrests, but how can they be expected to fight bandits to the death?

sentences.zh: 兩浙諸路以法案差弓手，必責正身，至有涕泣辭免者。

translations.literal: In the Liang-Zhe circuits, bowmen assigned by the statute must serve in person, to the point that some wept and begged to be excused.
translations.idiomatic: In the Liang-Zhe region, bowmen assigned under the statute must serve in person; some wept and begged to be released.

sentences.zh: 此豈可恃以為用哉？

translations.literal: How can this be relied upon for use?
translations.idiomatic: How can such men be relied upon?

sentences.zh: 今既立法許雇嚐為弓手而有勞效之人，比之泛募，宜有間矣。”

translations.literal: Now that the law permits hiring men who have once served as bowmen and shown meritorious performance, compared with indiscriminate recruitment there should be a difference.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the law permits hiring men who have previously served as bowmen with proven merit, the result should differ greatly from indiscriminate recruitment.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史呂陶謁告歸成都，因令與轉運司議定役法。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Censor Lü Tao, on leave petitioning to return to Chengdu, was therefore ordered to deliberate with the transport commission on fixing the service law.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Censor Lü Tao, granted leave to return to Chengdu, was instructed to work with the transport commission on finalizing the service law.

sentences.zh: 後議立增減役年之法曰：“戶多之鄉以十二年，戶少以九年，而應差之戶通輪一周。

translations.literal: Later they deliberated and established a law for increasing and decreasing years of service, stating: "In townships with many households, twelve years; where households are few, nine years—and households subject to assignment complete one full rotation.
translations.idiomatic: They later proposed a method for adjusting service years: "In populous townships the cycle shall be twelve years; in sparse townships nine years, until every liable household has served one full rotation.

sentences.zh: 以一周月日而參之戶等，戶稅多者占役之日多，少者以率減下，則均適無頗矣。

translations.literal: Taking one full cycle's days and comparing them to household ranks, those with more household tax occupy more days of service; those with less are reduced proportionally—then balance is achieved without bias.
translations.idiomatic: Within each cycle, days of service shall be apportioned by household rank: higher taxpayers serve more days, lower taxpayers fewer, in proportion—achieving balance without injustice.

sentences.zh: 雖以等周差，皆許募人為代，如此則四等往往少差，而五等差所不及矣。

translations.literal: Although assignment rotates by rank, all are permitted to recruit men as substitutes; thus fourth-rank households are often less often assigned, while fifth-rank assignment does not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: Although assignment still rotates by rank, all may hire substitutes—so fourth-rank households are rarely assigned, and fifth-rank households scarcely at all.

sentences.zh: 衙前悉令招募，以坊場錢支酬重難，此法為允。”

translations.literal: Yamen-runners are entirely ordered to be recruited, using market-stand money to pay heavy and difficult compensation—this method is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Yamen-runners shall all be recruited, with hazardous-duty pay drawn from market revenues—an acceptable arrangement.

sentences.zh: 當是時，議役法者皆下之詳定所，久不能決。

translations.literal: At this time, those debating the service law were all sent down to the detailed-determination office and for a long time could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: At that time every proposal on the service law was referred to the review commission, which deliberated for months without reaching a decision.

sentences.zh: 於是文彥博言：“差役之法，置局眾議，命令雜下，致久不決。”

translations.literal: Thereupon Wen Yanbo said: "The law of rotational assignment—establishing an office for collective debate, with mixed commands issued—caused long failure to decide."
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo then said: "The rotational-assignment system was sent to a commission for collective debate, while contradictory orders kept issuing from above, and nothing was decided for months."

sentences.zh: 於是詔罷詳定局，役法專隸戶部。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Thereupon an edict abolished the detailed-determination bureau; the service law was placed solely under the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark The court then abolished the review bureau and placed the service law solely under the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫鮮於侁言：“開封府多官戶，祥符縣至闔鄉止有一戶應差，請裁其濫。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Grandee Xianyu Shen said: "Kaifeng Prefecture has many official households; in Xiangfu County, for an entire township only one household was liable for assignment—please trim this excess.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Grandee Xianyu Shen said: "Kaifeng has many official households. In Xiangfu County an entire township had only one household liable for assignment. Please curb such abuses.

sentences.zh: 凡保甲之授班行者，如進納人例，須至升朝，方免色役。”

translations.literal: All those in the baojia system granted court audience ranks, following the precedent for tribute contributors, must reach promotion to court audience before being exempted from categorized service.
translations.idiomatic: All baojia members granted court audience ranks, like tribute contributors, should be exempt from categorized service only after reaching full court rank.

sentences.zh: 舊法，戶賦免役錢及三百緡者，令仍輸錢免役。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Under the old law, households whose assessed tax for exemption-from-service money reached three hundred strings were ordered still to pay money to exempt service.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark Under the old law, households whose exemption payments reached three hundred strings were still required to pay money in lieu of service.

sentences.zh: 侍御史王岩叟謂：“此法不見其利。

translations.literal: Attending Censor Wang Yansou said: "This law shows no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Censor Wang Yansou said: "This rule shows no benefit.

sentences.zh: 借如兩戶，其一輸錢及三百千，其一及二百八九十千，相去幾何，而應差者三年五年即得休息，其應輸助者畢世入錢，無有已時，非至破家，終不得免。

translations.literal: Suppose two households: one pays money reaching three thousand strings, the other reaching two thousand eight or nine hundred strings—how far apart are they? Yet those liable for assignment rest after three or five years, while those liable to pay assistance money pay money their whole lives without end; unless they reach bankruptcy, they are never exempt.
translations.idiomatic: Suppose two households: one pays three thousand strings in exemption money, the other two thousand eight or nine hundred. How great is the difference? Yet the household subject to rotation rests after three or five years, while the household paying assistance money pays for life without end. Unless ruined, it is never released.

sentences.zh: 此其勢必巧為免計，有弟兄則析居，不則鹹賣其業，但少降三百千之數，則遂可免。

translations.literal: Under this situation they will surely craft schemes for exemption: if they have brothers, they divide households; if not, they all sell their property—only slightly lowering the figure of three thousand strings, and then they can be exempt.
translations.idiomatic: They will inevitably contrive exemptions: brothers will divide households, or families will sell property—anything to drop just below three thousand strings and escape forever.

sentences.zh: 不出二三年，高強戶皆成中戶。”

translations.literal: Within no more than two or three years, all strong and powerful households will become middle households.
translations.idiomatic: Within two or three years every wealthy household will have been reduced to middle rank.

sentences.zh: 其後又詔：舊輸免役錢戶及百千以上，令如六色戶輸錢助役。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Later another edict stated: households that formerly paid exemption-from-service money of one hundred strings and above were ordered, like the six categories of households, to pay money to assist service.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark A later edict ordered households that formerly paid exemption money of one hundred strings or more to contribute assistance funds like the six service categories.

sentences.zh: 蓋欲以其錢廣雇，使番休優久。

translations.literal: This was because they wished to use their money to broaden hiring so that rotational rest would be ample and long.
translations.idiomatic: The aim was to broaden hiring with those funds so households could enjoy longer rest between rotations.

sentences.zh: 凡戶少之鄉，應差不及三番者，許以六色錢募州役；

translations.literal: In all townships with few households, where assignment did not reach three rotations, they were permitted to use the six categories of money to recruit for prefectural service;
translations.idiomatic: In townships with few households where rotation did not reach three cycles, the six categories of funds might recruit for prefectural service;

sentences.zh: 尚不及兩番，則申戶部，移用他州錢，以紓差期。

translations.literal: if still not reaching two rotations, then they reported to the Ministry of Revenue and transferred money from other prefectures to ease the period of assignment.
translations.idiomatic: if rotation fell short of even two cycles, they reported to the Ministry of Revenue to transfer funds from other prefectures and ease the assignment schedule.

sentences.zh: 鄉戶衙前受役，當休無代，即如募法給雇食之直；

translations.literal: When township households serving as yamen-runners had rest without substitute, they were given hire-food wages as under the recruitment law;
translations.idiomatic: When a township yamen-runner had no substitute during rest, he received food wages as under the recruitment law;

sentences.zh: 若願就投募者，仍免本戶身役，不願者，速募人代之。

translations.literal: if willing to enroll in recruitment, they were still exempted from their household's personal service; if unwilling, men were quickly recruited to replace them.
translations.idiomatic: if willing to enroll in permanent recruitment, the household was exempt from personal service; if unwilling, a substitute was recruited at once.

sentences.zh: 元祐二年，翰林學士兼侍讀蘇軾言：“差役之法，天下皆云未便。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanyou, Hanlin Academician and Concurrent Court Reader Su Shi said: "The law of rotational assignment—the whole realm says it is not convenient.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanyou, Hanlin Academician and Court Reader Su Shi said: "Everyone says the rotational-assignment system is unsatisfactory.

sentences.zh: 昔日雇役，中戶歲出幾何；

translations.literal: In former days under hired service, how much did middle households pay per year;
translations.idiomatic: Under the old hiring system, how much did a middle household pay each year?

sentences.zh: 今者差役，中戶歲費幾何。

translations.literal: now under rotational assignment, how much do middle households spend per year?
translations.idiomatic: Under rotational assignment, how much does a middle household spend each year?

sentences.zh: 更以幾年一役較之，約見其數，則利害灼然。

translations.literal: Further compare by how many years per rotation, and roughly see the figures—then benefit and harm are blazingly clear.
translations.idiomatic: Compare the totals over a full rotation cycle and the advantage or harm becomes obvious.

sentences.zh: 而況農民在官，官吏百端蠶食，比之雇人，苦樂十倍。

translations.literal: Moreover, when farmers serve in office, officials in a hundred ways devour them like silkworms—compared with hiring men, suffering and joy differ tenfold.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when farmers serve in government posts, officials exploit them in countless ways. Compared with hired laborers, their suffering is ten times greater.

sentences.zh: 五路百姓樸拙，間遇差為胥吏，又須轉雇慣習之人，尤為患苦。”

translations.literal: The common people of the Five Circuits are plain and clumsy; when occasionally assigned as clerks, they must in turn hire practiced men—this is especially a source of affliction.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the Five Circuits are plain and unworldly. When occasionally assigned as clerks, they must hire experienced men in turn—an especially painful burden.

sentences.zh: 尋詔郡縣各具差役法利害，條析以聞。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Soon an edict ordered each prefecture and county to set forth in detail the benefits and harms of the rotational-assignment law and report item by item.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark The court soon ordered every prefecture and county to report the benefits and harms of rotational assignment in detail.

sentences.zh: 四年，右正言劉安世言，御史中丞李常請復雇募，懷奸害政。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Right Rectifier Liu Anshi said that Censor-in-Chief Li Chang had requested restoring hired recruitment, harboring treachery and harming governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Right Rectifier Liu Anshi accused Censor-in-Chief Li Chang of seeking to restore hired recruitment out of treacherous intent harmful to governance.

sentences.zh: 先是，常言：“差法詔下，民知更不輸錢，嚐歡呼相慶。

translations.literal: Earlier, Chang had said: "When the edict on the rotational law was issued, the people knew they would no longer pay money and once shouted in mutual celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Chang had said: "When the rotational-assignment edict was issued, the people knew they would no longer pay money and once celebrated together.

sentences.zh: 行之既久，始覺不輸錢為害。

translations.literal: After it had been in force long, they began to realize that not paying money was harmful.
translations.idiomatic: After it had been in force for some time, they began to see that not paying money was itself a harm.

sentences.zh: 何也？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 差法廢久，版籍不明，重輕無準，鄉寬戶多者僅得更休，鄉狹戶窄者頻年在役。

translations.literal: The rotational law had been abandoned long; registers were unclear; heavy and light had no standard. In broad townships with many households, one barely got more rest; in narrow townships with few households, one was on duty year after year.
translations.idiomatic: The rotational system had been suspended so long that registers were unclear and burdens uneven. Broad townships with many households barely gained rest; narrow townships with few households served year after year.

sentences.zh: 上戶極等昔有歲輸百千至三百千者，今止差為弓手，雇人代役，歲不過用錢三四十千。

translations.literal: Highest-rank upper households formerly paid one hundred to three hundred thousand strings per year; now they are only assigned as bowmen and hire men to replace service, spending no more than thirty or forty thousand strings per year.
translations.idiomatic: The wealthiest upper households once paid one hundred to three hundred thousand strings yearly; now they are assigned only as bowmen and hire substitutes for no more than thirty or forty thousand strings a year.

sentences.zh: 中下戶舊輸錢不過三二千，而今所雇承符、散從之類，不下三十千。

translations.literal: Middle and lower households formerly paid no more than two or three thousand strings, but now those they hire—bearers of warrants, scattered attendants, and the like—cost no less than thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Middle and lower households once paid only two or three thousand strings, but the warrant-bearers and attendants they must hire now cost at least thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 然則今法徒能優便上戶，而三等、四等戶困苦日甚。

translations.literal: Thus the present law can only ease and convenience upper households, while third- and fourth-rank households' distress grows daily.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the present law only favors the wealthy, while third- and fourth-rank households grow more distressed every day.

sentences.zh: 望詔一二練事臣僚，使與賦臣取差雇二法便於百姓者行之。

translations.literal: We hope the court will order one or two experienced officials to join revenue officials in adopting whichever of the two methods—rotation or hiring—is convenient for the common people.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that one or two experienced officials join revenue officers in adopting whichever of rotation or hiring best serves the people.

sentences.zh: 無牽新書，無執舊說，民以為善，斯善矣。”

translations.literal: Do not be bound by new texts, do not cling to old doctrines—if the people deem it good, then it is good.
translations.idiomatic: Do not cling to new texts or old doctrines. If the people find it good, that is enough.

sentences.zh: 而安世則以責民出錢為非，乞固守差役初議，故以常為罪。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark But Anshi regarded holding the people responsible to pay money as wrong and begged to firmly maintain the initial proposal on rotational assignment; therefore he charged Chang with offense.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark Anshi, however, condemned any policy that made the people pay money and urged the court to hold firm to the original rotational-assignment plan. He therefore accused Li Chang.

sentences.zh: 知杭州蘇軾亦言：

translations.literal: Su Shi, Prefect of Hangzhou, also said:
translations.idiomatic: Su Shi, prefect of Hangzhou, also said:

sentences.zh: “改行差法，則上戶之害皆去。

translations.literal: "Changing to implement the rotational law, then the harms to upper households are all removed.
translations.idiomatic: "Switching to rotational assignment removed every burden on upper households.

sentences.zh: 獨有三等人戶，方雇役時，戶歲出錢極不過三四千，而令一役二年，當費七十餘千。

translations.literal: Only third-rank households: under hired service, a household paid at most three or four thousand per year, but now one rotation of two years costs more than seventy thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Only third-rank households suffered. Under hired service they paid at most three or four thousand strings a year, but one two-year rotation now costs more than seventy thousand.

sentences.zh: 休閑不過六年，則是八年之中，昔者徐出三十餘千，而今者並出七十餘千，苦樂可知。

translations.literal: Rest is no more than six years—thus within eight years, formerly they paid out slowly more than thirty thousand, but now they pay out all at once more than seventy thousand; suffering and joy can be known.
translations.idiomatic: With no more than six years of rest in eight, they once paid thirty thousand strings gradually but now pay seventy thousand at once. The contrast in hardship is obvious.

sentences.zh: 朝廷既取六色錢，許用雇役以代中戶，頗除一害，以全二利。

translations.literal: The court having taken the six categories of money and permitted using hired service to replace middle households largely removed one harm to secure two benefits.
translations.idiomatic: The court took the six categories of funds and allowed hiring to replace middle-household service, removing one harm while preserving two benefits.

sentences.zh: 今惟狹鄉戶少，役者替閑不及三番，方得用六色錢募人以代州役，此法未允。

translations.literal: Now only in narrow townships with few households, when those on service had rest and replacement of less than three rotations, may the six categories of money be used to recruit men to replace prefectural service—this law is not fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Now only in narrow townships with few households, when rotation falls short of three cycles, may the six categories of funds recruit replacements for prefectural service. This rule is unsatisfactory.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 百姓出錢本為免役，今乃限以番次，不用盡用。

translations.literal: The common people pay money originally to exempt service; now they are limited by rotation count and the funds are not fully used.
translations.idiomatic: The people paid money to escape service, yet the funds are limited by rotation cycles and not fully spent.

sentences.zh: 留錢在官，其名不正，又所雇者少，未足以紓中戶之勞。

translations.literal: Keeping money in government—its name is not correct, and moreover those hired are few, insufficient to ease middle households' labor.
translations.idiomatic: Money left in government coffers is unjust in name, and too few hires are made to ease middle-household burdens.

sentences.zh: 又投名衙前不足元額，而鄉差衙前又當更代，即又別差，更不支錢；

translations.literal: Moreover, enrolled long-term yamen-runners did not fill the original quota, while township-assigned yamen-runners again faced rotation—then another separate assignment was made without paying money;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, enrolled permanent yamen-runners did not fill the original quota, while township-assigned yamen-runners due for rotation were reassigned separately without pay;

sentences.zh: 若願就長名，則支酬重難盡以給之，仍計日月除其戶役及免助役錢二十千；

translations.literal: if willing to join long-term enrollment, hazardous-duty compensation was paid in full, and by counting days and months their household service and exemption from twenty thousand strings of assistance money were deducted;
translations.idiomatic: if willing to enroll permanently, full hazardous-duty pay was granted, with household service and twenty thousand strings of assistance money deducted by the day;

sentences.zh: 及州役惟吏人、衙前得皆雇募，此外悉用差法，如休役未及三年，即以助役錢支募，此法尤為未通。

translations.literal: as for prefectural service, only clerks and yamen-runners could all be hired and recruited; beyond this all used rotational assignment. If rest from service had not reached three years, assistance money was used to pay recruitment—this law was especially not coherent.
translations.idiomatic: for prefectural service only clerks and yamen-runners could be fully recruited; all else used rotation. If rest had not reached three years, assistance funds paid for recruitment—a rule especially incoherent.

sentences.zh: 自元豐前，不聞天下有闕額衙前者，豈嚐抑勒，直以重難月給可以足用故也。

translations.literal: Before Yuanfeng, one never heard of shortfall in yamen-runner quotas throughout the realm—had they ever been coerced? It was simply because monthly hazardous-duty pay could suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Before Yuanfeng no circuit reported unfilled yamen-runner quotas. Were men ever coerced? Monthly hazardous-duty pay simply sufficed.

sentences.zh: 當時奉使如李承之之徒，所至已輒減刻，元祐改法，又行減削，既多不支月給，如何肯就招募？

translations.literal: At that time commissioners such as Li Chengzhi, wherever they went, already routinely cut and reduced; the Yuanyou law change again carried reductions. Since monthly pay was often not disbursed, how would men be willing to enroll in recruitment?
translations.idiomatic: Even then commissioners like Li Chengzhi cut pay wherever they went. The Yuanyou reforms cut it again. With monthly wages often unpaid, who would volunteer for recruitment?

sentences.zh: 今不循其本，乃欲重困鄉差，全不支錢，而應募之人盡數支給，又放免役錢二千貫，欲以誘脅盡令應募，何如直添重難月給，令招募得行。

translations.literal: Now, not following the root, they wish to heavily afflict township assignment, paying no money at all, while giving full payment to those who enroll—and also remitting two thousand strings of exemption money, wishing by inducement and coercion to make all enroll. How about directly adding to monthly hazardous-duty pay so recruitment can proceed?
translations.idiomatic: Instead of addressing the root cause, the court would crush township assignees while paying recruits in full and remitting two thousand strings of exemption money to coerce enrollment. Why not simply raise monthly hazardous-duty pay so recruitment can work?

sentences.zh: 乞促招闕額長名衙前刻期須足，如合增錢雇募，上之監司，議定即行。

translations.literal: We beg to urge recruiting shortfall long-term yamen-runners with a fixed deadline that must be filled; if increased money for hiring recruitment is appropriate, report upward to supervisory officials, deliberate and fix it, and implement at once.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that unfilled permanent yamen-runner posts be filled by a fixed deadline. If higher wages are needed, report to supervisory officials, settle the amount, and implement at once.

sentences.zh: 役率以二年為一番，向來尚許一戶歇役不及三番，則令雇募，是欲百姓空閑六年。

translations.literal: Service rotation was generally two years per cycle; formerly it was still permitted that if one household's rest from service did not reach three rotations, then hiring was ordered—this was because they wished the common people six years of leisure.
translations.idiomatic: Service rotated every two years. Formerly, if a household's rest fell short of three cycles, hiring was permitted—giving the people six years free of duty.

sentences.zh: 今忽減作二年。

translations.literal: Now it was suddenly reduced to two years.
translations.idiomatic: Now that rest has suddenly been cut to two years.

sentences.zh: 幸六色錢足用有餘，正可加添番數，而乃減番添役，農民皆紛然妄謂朝廷移此錢他之。

translations.literal: Fortunately the six categories of money were sufficient with surplus—one could rightly add rotations, yet instead rotations were reduced and service increased. Farmers all clamored falsely that the court was moving this money elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Since the six categories of funds are ample, rotations should be increased, not reduced while duties increase. Farmers clamor that the court is diverting their money elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 雖雲量留一分備用，若有餘剩數，卻量減下無丁戶及女戶所敷役錢，此乃空言無實。

translations.literal: Although it is said that one-tenth is retained in reserve, if there is a surplus amount, it is instead assessed downward on households without adult males and female-headed households for their assessed service money—this is empty words without substance.
translations.idiomatic: Although a tenth is supposedly held in reserve, any surplus is used to reduce assessments on households without adult males and female-headed households—a promise without substance.

sentences.zh: 丁口、產稅開收增減，年年不同，如何前知來年應役而預為樁科？

translations.literal: Adult males, household tax, opening and collection, increases and decreases differ year by year—how can one know in advance next year's service and pre-assess and stake collection?
translations.idiomatic: Household size, tax assessments, and revenues change every year. How can officials know next year's service burden in advance and pre-allocate funds?

sentences.zh: 若亟行減下，臨期不足，又須增取，吏緣為奸，不可勝防矣。

translations.literal: If quickly carried out with reductions, when the deadline arrives and funds are insufficient, they must increase collection again; clerks take this as opportunity for fraud, impossible to guard against completely.
translations.idiomatic: If reductions are rushed through, shortfalls at deadline will force new levies—and clerks will exploit the chaos beyond all prevention.

sentences.zh: 大抵六色錢以免役取，當於雇役乎盡之，然後名正而人服。

translations.literal: Generally, the six categories of money are taken as exemption-from-service levies and ought to be fully spent on hired service; only then is the name correct and people submit.
translations.idiomatic: The six categories of funds were collected to buy exemption from service and should be spent entirely on hiring labor. Only then is the policy just and the people will accept it.

sentences.zh: 惟有一事不得不慮：州縣六色錢多少不同，若各隨多少以為之用，則敷錢多處，役戶優閑太久，六色人戶反覺敷錢數多。

translations.literal: Only one matter must be considered: the six categories of money in prefectures and counties differ in amount. If each follows its amount for use, then where assessed money is high, those on service enjoy leisure too long, while households of the six categories feel their assessed amounts are excessive.
translations.idiomatic: One problem remains: the six categories of funds vary by prefecture and county. If each locality spends only what it collects, wealthy districts enjoy excessive rest while contributors in high-assessment areas feel overcharged.

sentences.zh: 欲乞今後六色錢常存一年備用之數，而會計歲所當用，以贏餘而通一路，酌人戶貧富、色役多少預行品配，以一路六色錢能融分給，令州縣盡用雇人，以本處色役輕重為先後。

translations.literal: We wish to request that henceforth the six categories of money always retain one year's reserve, while calculating annual required expenditure, using surplus to circulate through a circuit, weighing households' wealth and poverty and the amount of categorized service to pre-assign by grade, so that one circuit's six categories of money can be blended and distributed, letting prefectures and counties fully hire men, with local categorized service heavy or light as the sequence.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that one year's reserve of the six categories always be kept, with annual needs calculated from surplus pooled across each circuit, apportioned by household wealth and duty weight, so every prefecture and county can hire fully—prioritizing the heaviest local duties first.

sentences.zh: 如此則錢均而無弊，雇人稍廣，中戶漸蘇，則差役良法可以久行而不變矣。”

translations.literal: Thus money would be even and without abuse; hiring would be somewhat broader and middle households gradually revive—then the good law of rotational assignment could long be practiced without change.
translations.idiomatic: Thus funds would be fairly distributed without abuse, hiring would expand, middle households would recover, and rotational assignment could endure.

sentences.zh: 是時，論役法未便者甚眾。

translations.literal: At this time, those who discussed the service law as inconvenient were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: At that time many officials argued that the service law remained unsatisfactory.

sentences.zh: 五年，再詔中書舍人王岩叟、樞密都承旨韓川、諫議大夫點檢戶曹文字劉安世同看詳利害。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, another edict ordered Secretariat Drafter Wang Yansou, Bureau of Military Affairs Duty Attendant Han Chuan, and Remonstrance Grandee Liu Anshi, who inspected Household Affairs documents, jointly to examine benefits and harms in detail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the court again ordered Secretariat drafter Wang Yansou, Bureau of Military Affairs duty attendant Han Chuan, and remonstrance grandee Liu Anshi, inspector of household-affairs documents, to review the law's benefits and harms together.

sentences.zh: 戶部請：“河北、河東、陝西鄉差衙前，以投募人所得雇直為則，而減半給之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue requested: "For township-assigned yamen-runners in Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi, take enrolled recruits' hire wages as the standard and pay half to those assigned.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue proposed: "For township-assigned yamen-runners in Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi, pay half the hire wage received by enrolled recruits.

sentences.zh: 投名衙前惟差耆長，他投皆免。”

translations.literal: For enrolled yamen-runners, only village elders are assigned by rotation; all other enrollments are exempt.
translations.idiomatic: Only village elders among enrolled yamen-runners shall be assigned by rotation; all other enrollees are exempt.

sentences.zh: 六年，三省援三路投募衙前役例，概行他路。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Three Departments cited the precedent of enrolled yamen-runner service in the Three Circuits and applied it generally to other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the Three Departments extended the Three Circuits' enrolled yamen-runner precedent to all other circuits.

sentences.zh: 詔：“凡投募人免其戶二等已下色役，鄉差人戶悉用投名人代之，願長投募者聽。”

translations.literal: An edict stated: "All who enroll are exempted from categorized service of the second rank and below in their household; township-assigned households all use enrolled men as substitutes, and those willing to enroll long-term are permitted."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Enrollees are exempt from second-rank and lower household duties; township assignees shall all be replaced by enrollees; long-term enrollment is permitted."

sentences.zh: 又詔：“諸州衙前已許量支雇直、餐錢，慮費廣難支，轉運、提刑司其隨土俗參酌立定優重分數及月給餐錢，用支酬額錢給之，不得過舊法元數。”

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Another edict stated: "In all prefectures, yamen-runners already permitted measured hire wages and meal money—fearing broad expense would be hard to sustain, transport and judicial investigation commissions should according to local custom deliberate and fix preferential weight fractions and monthly meal money, disbursing from compensation-quota funds, not exceeding the original law's amounts."
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark Another edict stated: "Prefectures already pay measured hire wages and meal allowances to yamen-runners. Fearing excessive cost, transport and judicial investigation commissions shall set preferential rates and monthly meal allowances by local custom, drawing from compensation funds without exceeding original-law amounts."

sentences.zh: 州役之應鄉差者，若一鄉人戶終役皆未及四年，許以助役錢募人為之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark For prefectural service subject to township assignment, if in one township households completing service had all not reached four years, they were permitted to use assistance money to recruit men to perform it.
translations.idiomatic: For prefectural duties still assigned by township rotation, if no household in a township had completed four years of service, assistance funds might recruit replacements.

sentences.zh: 總計一州雇直，其助役錢不足用，即於戶狹役煩鄉分先與雇代一役，役竟按籍復差如初。

translations.literal: Totalling one prefecture's hire wages, if assistance money was insufficient, then in townships with few households and frequent service, one rotation was first hired in advance; when service ended, assignment by register resumed as before.
translations.idiomatic: If a prefecture's assistance funds could not cover hire wages, narrow townships with heavy burdens might hire one rotation in advance, then resume normal assignment from the register when it ended.

sentences.zh: 諸州歲計助役錢常留一分外，以雇直對計，或闕或剩，提刑司通一路移用。

translations.literal: In all prefectures, annual assistance money beyond the one-tenth always retained was matched against hire wages; whether short or surplus, the judicial investigation commission transferred funds across the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture's annual assistance funds, beyond the one-tenth reserve, were balanced against hire wages; shortfalls or surpluses were adjusted circuit-wide by the judicial investigation commission.

sentences.zh: 應差諸縣手力，合一鄉休役皆不及三年者，亦許用助役錢雇募；

translations.literal: For all counties' hand-power subject to assignment, if in one township rest from service all fell short of three years, hiring with assistance money was also permitted;
translations.idiomatic: Where county hand-power was assigned by rotation, if every household in a township had rested less than three years, assistance funds might also hire replacements;

sentences.zh: 既終一役，別有閑及三年者，復行差法。

translations.literal: after one rotation ended, if separately there was leisure reaching three years, the rotational-assignment law was again implemented.
translations.idiomatic: after one rotation ended, if three years of rest had accumulated, rotational assignment resumed.

sentences.zh: 諸州縣置差役都鼠尾簿，取民戶稅產、物力高下差取，分五等排定，而疏其色役年月及其更代人姓名於逐戶之下。

translations.literal: All prefectures and counties established comprehensive rotational-assignment registers with trailing entries, taking households' tax property and material wealth high and low for assignment, arranging five ranks, and listing categorized service years and replacement persons' names under each household.
translations.idiomatic: Every prefecture and county kept a master rotational-assignment register ranking households by tax property and wealth into five grades, recording each duty's years of service and replacements beneath each name.

sentences.zh: 每遇差役，即按籍自上而下，吏毋得移竄先後。

translations.literal: Whenever service was assigned, they followed the register from top to bottom; clerks might not shift the sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Assignments followed the register from top to bottom; clerks could not alter the order.

sentences.zh: 坊場、河渡錢以雇衙前而有寬剩，亦令補助其餘役人。

translations.literal: Market-stand and ferry-crossing money, having surplus after hiring yamen-runners, was also ordered to subsidize other persons on service.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus market-stand and ferry revenues after hiring yamen-runners were also used to subsidize other service personnel.

sentences.zh: 三省言：

translations.literal: The Three Departments said:
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments reported:

sentences.zh: “朝廷審定民役，差募兼行，斟酌補除，極為詳備；

translations.literal: "The court examined and fixed commoners' service duties, with rotation and recruitment practiced together and relief and exemption weighed—extremely detailed and complete;
translations.idiomatic: "The court has fixed commoners' service duties with rotation and recruitment combined and relief carefully weighed—an extremely detailed system;

sentences.zh: 而州縣不盡用助役錢募人，以補頻役之地。

translations.literal: yet prefectures and counties do not fully use assistance money to recruit men to supplement places of frequent service.
translations.idiomatic: yet prefectures and counties do not fully use assistance funds to hire men for the most burdened districts.

sentences.zh: 今括具綱目，下之州縣，使恪承之。

translations.literal: Now we compile and list the outline and send it down to prefectures and counties, making them respectfully carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: We now compile an outline and send it to every prefecture and county for strict compliance.

sentences.zh: 其一曰：應差之戶，三等以上許休役四年，四等以下許休役六年。

translations.literal: The first item states: households subject to assignment of the third rank and above are permitted four years' rest from service; fourth rank and below, six years.
translations.idiomatic: First: households of the third rank and above may rest four years between duties; fourth rank and below, six years.

sentences.zh: 若戶少無與更代，卸役不及應閑年數，即用助役錢募人代役以足之。

translations.literal: If households are few with no one to replace, and release from service does not reach the required years of leisure, then use assistance money to recruit men to replace service until complete.
translations.idiomatic: If households are too few to rotate and rest falls short of the required years, assistance funds shall hire replacements until the quota is met.

sentences.zh: 其二曰：狹鄉之縣役人，除衙前州胥許雇、壯丁直差不雇外，凡州縣役人皆許招募，以就募月日補除應差而閑不及四年、六年之人，使及年數。

translations.literal: The second item states: in narrow townships' county service personnel, except yamen-runners and prefectural clerks who are permitted hiring while strong youths are assigned by rotation without hiring, all other prefectural and county service personnel are permitted recruitment, using enrollment months and days to compensate and exempt those assigned who have leisure falling short of four or six years, bringing them to the required years.
translations.idiomatic: Second: in narrow townships, except yamen-runners and prefectural clerks who may be hired while strong youths remain on rotation, all other county personnel may be recruited; enrollment dates count toward the four- or six-year rest periods of assigned households.

sentences.zh: 每縣通計應差、應募役數若干，立定二額：差者訖役，以應差人承之；

translations.literal: Each county totals how many assignments and recruitments are required and fixes two quotas: when assignees finish service, those subject to assignment take over;
translations.idiomatic: Each county shall fix two quotas for assignments and recruitments: when assignees finish, the next assigned household takes over;

sentences.zh: 雇者有闕，別募人充數。

translations.literal: if recruits have vacancies, separately recruit men to fill the numbers.
translations.idiomatic: if recruited posts fall vacant, new recruits shall fill them.

sentences.zh: 二額悉已立定，如戶力應升應降，須俟三年造簿日按籍別定；

translations.literal: When both quotas are fixed, if household strength should rise or fall in rank, one must wait for the three-year register-making day to fix by register separately;
translations.idiomatic: Once both quotas are fixed, rank changes must wait for the triennial register revision;

sentences.zh: 未應造簿，止憑定額為準。

translations.literal: before register-making is due, only the fixed quotas serve as standard.
translations.idiomatic: until then the fixed quotas alone govern.

sentences.zh: 若本等戶少，不充州縣合役之數，即用次等戶之物力及本等七分者為之。

translations.literal: If households of the original rank are few and do not fill the prefecture and county combined service quota, then use the next rank's material wealth and those of the original rank at seven-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: If the original rank cannot fill the county quota, the next rank may serve, or households of the original rank at seven-tenths of normal wealth.

sentences.zh: 其三曰：寬鄉之縣，除已雇衙前、州胥外，餘役皆以序按差。

translations.literal: The third item states: in broad townships' counties, except already hired yamen-runners and prefectural clerks, remaining service is all assigned in sequence by rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Third: in broad townships, except hired yamen-runners and prefectural clerks, all other duties rotate in order.

sentences.zh: 其四曰：官雇弓手，先雇嚐充弓手之人，如不足，以武勇有雇籍者充。

translations.literal: The fourth item states: officially hired bowmen—first hire men who have once served as bowmen; if insufficient, fill with the martial and brave who have hiring registers.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: official bowmen shall first be hired from men who have previously served as bowmen; if insufficient, from registered martial men.

sentences.zh: 他役人願就雇，其選受亦如之。

translations.literal: Other service personnel willing to accept hiring—selection and appointment follow the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: Other personnel volunteering for hire are selected by the same rules.

sentences.zh: 其五曰：壯丁皆按戶版簿名次實輪充役，半年而更。

translations.literal: The fifth item states: strong youths are all assigned by household register order in actual rotation, changing every half year.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: strong youths rotate in strict register order, changing every half year.

sentences.zh: 其六曰：一州一路有狹鄉役頻縣分，募錢不足，提刑司以一路助役寬剩錢通融移用；

translations.literal: The sixth item states: where in one prefecture or circuit there are narrow townships with frequent service and insufficient recruitment money, the judicial investigation commission uses one circuit's surplus assistance funds for flexible transfer;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: where narrow townships lack recruitment funds, the judicial investigation commission shall transfer surplus assistance funds circuit-wide;

sentences.zh: 又不足，以坊場、河渡寬剩錢給之。

translations.literal: if still insufficient, supply from surplus market-stand and ferry money.
translations.idiomatic: if still insufficient, from surplus market and ferry revenues.

sentences.zh: 仍通紐一歲應用支酬衙前之類費錢若干，而十分率之，每年於寬剩數內更留二分，以備支酬衙前之類，樁留至五年，通迭一全年寬剩總額，即止不樁；

translations.literal: Still compile and link one year's required expenditure for compensating yamen-runners and the like, and rate it by tenths; each year from surplus retain two more tenths to prepare for compensating yamen-runners and the like, staking reserve up to five years, then rotate through one full year's total surplus and stop further staking;
translations.idiomatic: Also calculate annual payments for yamen-runners and similar duties; each year retain two-tenths of surplus for five years as a rolling reserve for such payments, then stop further accumulation;

sentences.zh: 又不足，戶部以別路逐色寬剩錢移用以補足之。

translations.literal: if still insufficient, the Ministry of Revenue uses surplus funds of other circuits by category to transfer and supplement.
translations.idiomatic: if still insufficient, the Ministry of Revenue shall transfer surplus funds from other circuits.

sentences.zh: 其七曰：助錢歲歲樁留一分，每及五分止，或時支用，即隨撥補，使常足五分之數。

translations.literal: The seventh item states: assistance money each year stakes one-tenth in reserve, stopping at five-tenths; if spent in emergencies, replenish immediately so it always reaches five-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: one-tenth of assistance funds shall be reserved yearly until five-tenths is reached; emergency spending shall be replenished at once to maintain five-tenths.

sentences.zh: 其八曰：“軍人應差迓送者，本以代有雇錢役人，其沿迓送軍人有費，提刑司計數歸之轉運司。

translations.literal: The eighth item states: "Soldiers assigned for escort duty originally replaced service personnel who received hire money; expenses for escort soldiers along the route—the judicial investigation commission counts and returns them to the transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: "Soldiers assigned to escort duty replaced paid service personnel; escort expenses shall be counted by the judicial investigation commission and charged to the transport commission.

sentences.zh: 其九曰：重役人應替而願仍就募者，許給雇錢受役。

translations.literal: The ninth item states: heavy-duty personnel due for replacement who wish still to enroll in recruitment are permitted hire money while serving.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth: heavy-duty personnel due for replacement who wish to re-enroll may receive hire wages while serving.

sentences.zh: 其十曰：役人須有稅產乃得就募。

translations.literal: The tenth item states: persons on service must have taxable property before they may enroll in recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth: recruits must hold taxable property.

sentences.zh: 其有蔭應贖及曾犯徒刑，雖願募不雇。

translations.literal: Those with hereditary redemption privileges or who have committed penal servitude, though willing to enroll, are not hired.
translations.idiomatic: Men with hereditary redemption privileges or penal-servitude convictions shall not be hired even if willing.

sentences.zh: 若工藝人，須有貲產人二戶任之。

translations.literal: If artisans, two households with property must stand surety.
translations.idiomatic: Artisans require two propertied households as guarantors.

sentences.zh: 雇直雖多，皆不得加於舊法已募之數。

translations.literal: Although hire wages may be high, none may exceed the numbers already recruited under the old law.
translations.idiomatic: Hire wages may not exceed rates under the old law.

sentences.zh: 其十一曰：陝西鎮戎德順軍、熙州衙前，皆受田於官以當募直，內地戶願如其法應田募者聽之，仍以坊場、河渡補還轉運司合輸租課。”

translations.literal: The eleventh item states: yamen-runners at Zhenrong Deshun Army and Xi Prefecture in Shaanxi all receive fields from government in lieu of recruitment wages; inland households willing to follow this method and accept fields for recruitment are permitted, still using market-stand and ferry funds to repay the transport commission's required rent and levies.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh: yamen-runners at Zhenrong Deshun Army and Xi Prefecture in Shaanxi receive government fields in lieu of wages; inland households may follow the same method, with market and ferry revenues repaying the transport commission's rent.

sentences.zh: 凡縣，歲具色役輕重、鄉分寬狹、凡役雇直有無餘欠，各以其實枚別而上之州。

translations.literal: In all counties, each year they report in detail upward to the prefecture the weight of categorized service, breadth or narrowness of townships, and whether hire wages for all service had surplus or shortfall, each according to fact.
translations.idiomatic: Each county shall annually report to the prefecture the weight of each duty, whether townships are broad or narrow, and whether hire funds showed surplus or deficit.

sentences.zh: 州上監司，監司聚議，連書上戶部。

translations.literal: Prefectures report upward to supervisory officials; supervisory officials convene for discussion and memorialize jointly to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures report to supervisory officials, who convene and memorialize the Ministry of Revenue jointly.

sentences.zh: 仍別具一路移用及寬剩縣分錢數，致之戶部。

translations.literal: They also separately list circuit-wide transfers and surplus funds of counties with surplus, forwarding to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: They shall also report circuit-wide transfers and counties with surplus funds to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 先是，收到官田，嚐令：田已籍於官及見佃人逃亡，悉拘入之，留充雇募衙前。

translations.literal: Earlier, when confiscated government fields were received, it was once ordered: fields already registered to government and current tenants who fled were all seized and retained to supply recruited yamen-runners.
translations.idiomatic: When confiscated government fields were received, an order once directed that fields registered to the government whose tenants had fled be seized to support recruited yamen-runners.

sentences.zh: 至是，遂參行田募之法。

translations.literal: At this point, the field-recruitment method was implemented in reference.
translations.idiomatic: The field-recruitment method was now put into practice.

sentences.zh: 八年，詔：“耆長、壯丁役期已足，不許連續為之。”

translations.literal: In the eighth year, an edict stated: "Village elders and strong youths whose service terms are complete may not serve continuously."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, an edict stated: "Village elders and strong youths whose terms are complete may not serve consecutive terms."

sentences.zh: 蓋知其利於賕請，不願更罷故也。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark This was because it was known they profited from bribes and were unwilling to step down.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark The court knew they profited from bribes and refused to leave office.

sentences.zh: 民有執父母喪而應在役者，三等以下戶除之，三等以上戶令量納役錢，在戶錢十分止責輸三分，服除日仍舊。

translations.literal: Commoners holding parents' mourning who should be on service—households of the third rank and below are exempted; households of the third rank and above are ordered to pay a measured amount of service money, from household funds taking only three-tenths of ten-tenths; when mourning ends, they resume as before.
translations.idiomatic: Households in mourning for parents who would otherwise serve: third rank and below are exempt; third rank and above pay three-tenths of their assessed service money until mourning ends.

sentences.zh: 哲宗始親政，三省言役法尚未就緒，帝曰：“第行元豐舊法，而減去寬剩錢，百姓何有不便？”

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong first personally took governance, the Three Departments said the service law was not yet complete. The Emperor said: "Just implement the old Yuanfeng law and remove surplus money—how could the common people be inconvenienced?"
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong first took personal rule, the Three Departments said the service law was unfinished. The emperor said: "Simply restore the Yuanfeng law and remove surplus collections—how could the people be harmed?"

sentences.zh: 範純仁曰：“四方異宜，須因民立法，乃可久也。”

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Fan Chunren said: "The four quarters differ in suitability; one must legislate according to the people—only then can it endure."
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark Fan Chunren said: "Regions differ; law must follow the people—only then can it endure."

sentences.zh: 遂令戶部議之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Thereupon the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark The Ministry of Revenue was ordered to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 右司諫朱勃言：“輸錢免役，有過數多敷者；

translations.literal: Right Bureau Remonstrator Zhu Bo said: "Paying money to exempt service—there are cases of excessive collection beyond quota;
translations.idiomatic: Right Bureau remonstrator Zhu Bo said: "Exemption payments sometimes exceed the quota;

sentences.zh: 用錢雇役，有立直太重者；

translations.literal: using money to hire service—there are cases of fixed wages set too high;
translations.idiomatic: hired service sometimes sets wages too high;

sentences.zh: 役色之內，又有優便而願自投募，不必給雇者。

translations.literal: within service categories, there are also preferential and convenient ones where men wish to enroll themselves without needing hire pay.
translations.idiomatic: some duties are so light that men volunteer without wages.

sentences.zh: 請詳為裁省。”

translations.literal: We request detailed trimming and reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Please trim these abuses in detail.

sentences.zh: 中書言：“自行差法十年，民間苦於差擾，前後議者紛紜，更變不一，未有底止。”

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark The Secretariat said: "Since rotational assignment was implemented for ten years, the populace has suffered from assignment harassment; discussants before and after have been numerous and confused, with changes not uniform and no end in sight.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark The Secretariat replied: "For ten years under rotational assignment the people have suffered harassment; debate has been endless and changes constant, with no end in sight.

sentences.zh: 於是詔：“復免役法，凡條約悉用元豐八年見製。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict stated: "Restore the exemption-from-service law; all regulations shall use the system as seen in the eighth year of Yuanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then declared: "Restore the exemption-from-service law under the Yuanfeng eighth-year regulations.

sentences.zh: 鄉差役人，有應募者可以更代，即罷遣之。

translations.literal: Township-assigned persons on service, if there are those willing to enroll, may be replaced and then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Township assignees may be replaced and dismissed when volunteers enroll.

sentences.zh: 許借坊場、河渡及封樁錢以為雇直，須有役錢日補足其數。

translations.literal: They are permitted to borrow market-stand, ferry, and sealed-reserve money as hire wages, but must replenish the amount on days when service money is due.
translations.idiomatic: Market, ferry, and sealed-reserve funds may be borrowed for hire wages but must be repaid when service revenues arrive.

sentences.zh: 所輸免役錢，自今年七月始。

translations.literal: Exemption-from-service money paid shall begin from the seventh month of this year.
translations.idiomatic: Exemption payments shall begin this seventh month.

sentences.zh: 耆戶長、壯丁召雇，不得已保正、保長、保丁充代，其他役色應雇者放此。

translations.literal: Village heads, household heads, and strong youths are recruited; if unavoidable, security chiefs, security heads, and security youths serve as substitutes; other service categories subject to hiring follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Village heads, household heads, and strong youths shall be recruited; if necessary, security officers may substitute; other hired duties follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 所敷寬剩錢，不得過一分，昔常過數、今應減下者，先自下五等人戶始。

translations.literal: Surplus money assessed must not exceed one-tenth; where formerly excessive and now to be reduced, begin from households of the fifth rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus assessments may not exceed one-tenth; reductions shall begin with fifth-rank households and below.

sentences.zh: 路置提舉官一員，視提刑置司之州為治。

translations.literal: Each circuit shall place one supervisory official, taking as seat of office the prefecture where the judicial investigation commission is located.
translations.idiomatic: Each circuit shall appoint one supervisory official based where the judicial investigation commission sits.

sentences.zh: 如方俗利害不同，事有未盡未便而應更改增損舊法者，畫一條疏，與轉運、提刑司連奏。”

translations.literal: If local customs differ in benefit and harm, and matters remain incomplete or inconvenient and the old law should be changed, increased, or reduced, set forth item by item in one memorial jointly with transport and judicial investigation commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Where local conditions require changes to the old law, itemized proposals shall be submitted jointly with transport and judicial investigation commissions.

sentences.zh: 又詔：用舊法取量添酒錢贏數，給惟法司吏餐錢；

translations.literal: Another edict: use the old law to take the surplus from added wine-tax levies to supply meal money for legal-affairs clerks;
translations.idiomatic: Another edict: surplus from added wine taxes under the old law shall pay legal-affairs clerks' meal allowances;

sentences.zh: 不足，則抵當息錢亦許貼用。

translations.literal: if insufficient, pawn-interest money may also be used to supplement.
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient, pawn-interest funds may supplement.

sentences.zh: 先嚐以七月起輸，其後又自來年始。

translations.literal: Earlier it was once ordered that collection begin in the seventh month; afterward it again began from the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: Collection was first ordered to begin in the seventh month, then postponed to the following year.

sentences.zh: 土俗差雇不一，姑仍其舊，俟起輸，至五月盡行雇法，凡因差在役者悉罷遣之。

translations.literal: Local customs differ in assignment and hiring; for the moment keep the old practice, wait until collection begins, and by the fifth month fully implement the hiring law—all those on service by assignment are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Local assignment and hiring customs differ; for now keep existing practice until collection begins, then by the fifth month fully implement hiring and dismiss all assignees.

sentences.zh: 舊免役法行，壯丁間有差而不募者，其毋敷役錢如故。

translations.literal: When the old exemption-from-service law was in force, among strong youths some were assigned by rotation without recruitment; they are not assessed service money as before.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old exemption law some strong youths were assigned rather than recruited and paid no service money, as before.

sentences.zh: 凡錢額所敷，取三年雇直實支，而酌一年中數，立為歲額，以均敷取。

translations.literal: For all money amounts assessed, take three years' actual hire-wage expenditure and weigh the median of one year, establishing the annual quota for even assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Assessments shall be based on three years' actual hire costs, using the median year as the annual quota.

sentences.zh: 此外所取寬餘，不得過通額十分之一。

translations.literal: Beyond this, surplus taken must not exceed one-tenth of the total quota.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus collected beyond this may not exceed one-tenth of the total quota.

sentences.zh: 免役錢方復未輸，且以助役錢給雇直，不足，雖免役寬剩錢亦許給用。

translations.literal: Exemption money had not yet been paid when restored; for the moment use assistance money for hire wages; if insufficient, even exemption surplus money is permitted for use.
translations.idiomatic: Before exemption payments resumed, assistance funds paid hire wages; if insufficient, exemption surplus might also be used.

sentences.zh: 七月，戶部看詳役法所言：“幕職監當官之官、罷官，依元豐製，悉用雇役人迓送而差定其數，凡元祐溢額所添廂軍皆罷減。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Ministry of Revenue's review of the service law stated: "For staff and supervisory officials, officials on leave—following Yuanfeng regulations, all use hired personnel for escort while fixing the numbers; all extra garrison troops added in Yuanyou beyond quota are dismissed and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Ministry of Revenue reported: "Staff and supervisory officials on leave shall use hired escorts under Yuanfeng rules at fixed numbers; all Yuanyou garrison additions beyond quota are dismissed.

sentences.zh: 其有抑鄉差之人仍舊在役，或改易名字就便應募，悉計其在役月日應得更代者，以次蠲遣之。

translations.literal: Where township-assigned persons are still suppressed and remain on service, or change names to conveniently enroll, all count their months on service and those due for replacement—dismiss in sequence with exemptions.
translations.idiomatic: Township assignees still serving, or who changed names to enroll, shall be dismissed in order as their replacement dates arrive.

sentences.zh: 諸路舊立出等高強戶，力轉高，敷取難勝，應出免役錢百千以上，每累及百千，悉與減免三分。

translations.literal: In all circuits, formerly established extra-high strong households, whose strength kept rising and assessments became unbearable—those owing exemption money of one hundred strings and above, for every additional hundred strings accumulated, all receive a reduction of three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Extra-high strong households whose assessments had grown unbearable shall receive a thirty-percent reduction for every hundred strings of exemption money owed above the first hundred.

sentences.zh: 凡人戶匿寄財產、假借戶貫、冒名官戶苟可避免等第科配者，各以違製論；

translations.literal: All who conceal and deposit property, borrow household registers, or falsely claim official household status to avoid rank assignment—each is judged under violation of regulations;
translations.idiomatic: Those who conceal property, borrow registers, or falsely claim official status to avoid assessment shall be punished for violating regulations;

sentences.zh: 許人陳告，以其半給之。

translations.literal: informants are permitted to report, and half is given to them.
translations.idiomatic: informants shall receive half the confiscated property.

sentences.zh: 元豐令：在籍宗子及太皇太后、皇后緦麻親得免役。

translations.literal: Yuanfeng decree: imperial clansmen on the register and consanguines within mourning dress of the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress are exempt from service.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanfeng code exempted registered imperial clansmen and mourning kin of the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress.

sentences.zh: 皇太妃宜亦如之。”

translations.literal: The Imperial Consort Dowager should likewise be so.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Consort Dowager should receive the same exemption.

sentences.zh: 詔皆如請。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark Edicts all followed the request.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark The court approved all requests.

sentences.zh: 舊戶等簿，如略可憑即用之，若漫滅等第，即雖未及應造之年，亦令改造。

translations.literal: Old household-rank registers, if they can be relied on in brief, are used; if ranks are blurred and extinguished, then even if the year for making registers has not arrived, they are ordered to remake them.
translations.idiomatic: Old household registers may be used if still reliable; if ranks are illegible, new registers shall be made even before the triennial deadline.

sentences.zh: 戶部舉行元豐條製，以保正長代耆長，甲頭代戶長，承帖人代壯丁。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue implemented Yuanfeng regulations, using security chiefs in place of village elders, cell heads in place of household heads, and warrant-bearers in place of strong youths.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue implemented Yuanfeng rules, replacing village elders with security chiefs, household heads with cell heads, and strong youths with warrant-bearers.

sentences.zh: 二年，申詔諸路：“役人額數、雇直，並依元豐舊制，仍依已命，寬剩錢不得過一分。

translations.literal: In the second year, a memorial edict to all circuits stated: "Service personnel quotas and hire wages shall all follow Yuanfeng old regulations, still according to prior orders that surplus money must not exceed one-tenth.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict to all circuits stated: "Service quotas and hire wages shall follow Yuanfeng regulations, with surplus collections still capped at one-tenth.

sentences.zh: 常平免役，元豐上用提舉官專領，轉運、提刑司自今毋預其事。”

translations.literal: Ever-Normal Granary and exemption-from-service funds—in Yuanfeng supervised officials alone managed them; transport and judicial investigation commissions from now on shall not intervene in these matters.
translations.idiomatic: Ever-Normal Granary and exemption funds, under Yuanfeng managed solely by supervisory officials, shall no longer involve transport or judicial investigation commissions.

sentences.zh: 舊置重修編敕所看詳中外文字本，以去年所差鄉役未盡善，遂入議曰：“都、副保正比耆長事責已輕，又有承帖人受行文書，即大保長苦無公事。

translations.literal: The formerly established Office for Revision and Compilation of Statutes, reviewing domestic and foreign textual editions, because last year's township service assignment was not entirely good, entered deliberation, saying: "Chief and deputy security chiefs compared with village elders already have lighter responsibilities, and moreover warrant-bearers receive documents—thus great security chiefs suffer without official business.
translations.idiomatic: The office revising statutory compilations, reviewing domestic regulations, noted that last year's township service assignments were flawed and proposed: "Chief and deputy security chiefs already bear lighter duties than village elders, and warrant-bearers handle documents—leaving great security chiefs with little real work.

sentences.zh: 元豐本製，一都之內，役者十人，副正之外，八保各差一大長。

translations.literal: Under the original Yuanfeng system, within one security district ten persons served; beyond the deputy chief, each of eight security cells assigned one great cell head.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yuanfeng rules, ten men served each security district: besides the deputy chief, each of eight cells appointed one great cell head.

sentences.zh: 今若常輪二大長分催十保稅租、常平錢物，一稅一替，則自不必更輪保丁充甲頭矣。

translations.literal: If now two great cell heads regularly rotate to press the ten cells for tax rent and Ever-Normal Granary funds, one tax collection per replacement, then naturally there is no need further to rotate security youths as cell heads.
translations.idiomatic: If two great cell heads rotate to collect taxes and Ever-Normal funds from the ten cells, one term per tax cycle, security youths need no longer serve as cell heads.

sentences.zh: 凡都保所雇承帖人，必選家於本保者，而雇直皆從官給，一年一替，則自無浮浪稽留符移之弊。

translations.literal: All warrant-bearers hired by the security district must be chosen from families within that district, and hire wages are all paid by government, one year per replacement—then naturally there is no abuse of floating idlers delaying and retaining documents.
translations.idiomatic: Warrant-bearers must be chosen from the district itself, paid by government wages yearly—eliminating idlers who delay official documents.

sentences.zh: 承帖雇直固有舊數，其今所雇保正之直示耆長，保長之直則視戶長；

translations.literal: Warrant-bearers' hire wages inherently have old amounts; the present hire wages for security chiefs are shown as village elders', and security heads' wages follow household heads';
translations.idiomatic: Warrant-bearers' wages keep their old rates; security chiefs' wages match village elders', and security heads' wages match household heads';

sentences.zh: 若應此三役不願替代者，自從其願。
