translations.idiomatic: Chunxi eighth year: drought districts sold relief grain; the destitute without money received charity rice.

sentences.zh: 寧宗慶元元年，以兩浙轉運副使沈詵言米價翔踴，凡商販之家盡令出糶，而告藏之令設矣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingyuan, Liang-Zhe transport vice commissioner Shen Qian, because rice prices soared, ordered all merchant households to sell out—and the order to report hoarding was established.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan first year, because prices soared, merchants were ordered to sell out and hoarding was reported.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十六年，詔於楚州所儲米撥二萬石濟山東、西。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Jiading, an edict allocated twenty thousand shi from Chu Prefecture stores to relieve Shandong East and West.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading sixteenth year allocated twenty thousand shi from Chu Prefecture to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 淳熙八年，浙東提舉朱熹言：“乾道四年民艱食，熹請於府，得常平米六百石振貸，夏受粟於倉，冬則加息計米以償。

translations.literal: Chunxi eighth year, Zhu Xi said: in Qiandao fourth year he lent six hundred shi Ever-Normal grain—summer issue, winter repay with interest.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi eighth year, Zhu Xi said: in Qiandao fourth year he lent six hundred shi Ever-Normal grain—summer issue, winter repay with interest.

sentences.zh: 自後隨年斂散，歉，蠲其息之半；

translations.literal: Thereafter yearly collection and dispersal; in lean years, half the interest was remitted;
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter yearly cycle; lean years halved interest;

sentences.zh: 大饑，即盡蠲之。

translations.literal: in great famine, all interest was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: great famine remitted all interest.

sentences.zh: 凡十有四年，得息米造倉三間，及以元數六百石還府。

translations.literal: Altogether fourteen years—interest grain built three granary rooms and returned the original six hundred shi to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In fourteen years interest built three granaries and returned six hundred shi to the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 見儲米三千一百石，以為社倉，不復收息，每石隻收耗米三升。

translations.literal: Currently stored three thousand one hundred shi as a community granary, no longer collecting interest—each shi only collects three sheng loss rice.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand one hundred shi remained as a community granary charging only three sheng loss per shi.

sentences.zh: 以故一鄉四五十里間，雖遇凶年，人不闕食。

translations.literal: Thus within one township forty or fifty li, even in bad years people did not lack food.
translations.idiomatic: Within forty or fifty li, even bad years brought no hunger.

sentences.zh: 請以是行於倉司。”

translations.literal: Please implement this in granary offices.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to spread this through granary offices.

sentences.zh: 時陸九淵在敕令局，見之歎曰：“社倉幾年矣，有司不復舉行，所以遠方無知者。”

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark At that time Lu Jiuyuan was in the Statutes Bureau, saw it and sighed: "Community granaries have existed years, but executive offices no longer implement—therefore distant places have no knowledge."
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jiuyuan in the Statutes Bureau sighed that community granaries were known but not implemented afar.

sentences.zh: 遂編入《振恤》”

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark It was then compiled into Relief and Succor."
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark It was compiled into the Relief section.

sentences.zh: 〈（凡借貸者，十家為甲，甲推其人為之首；

translations.literal: (For all borrowers, ten households form a group; the group elects one as head;
translations.idiomatic: (Borrowers formed groups of ten households with elected heads;

sentences.zh: 五十家則擇一通曉者為社首。

translations.literal: fifty households then choose one who understands as community head.
translations.idiomatic: fifty households chose a literate community head.

sentences.zh: 每年正月，告示社首，下都結甲。

translations.literal: Each year in the first month, announce to the community head, below the district form groups.
translations.idiomatic: Each first month the community head organized groups.

sentences.zh: 其有逃軍及無行之人，與有稅錢衣食不闕者，並不得入甲。

translations.literal: Deserters and men without conduct, and those with tax money and clothing not lacking, may not enter a group.
translations.idiomatic: Deserters, vagabonds, and the well-off could not join.

sentences.zh: 其應入甲者，又問其願與不願。

translations.literal: Those who should enter a group are again asked whether they wish to or not.
translations.idiomatic: Eligible households were asked whether they wished to join.

sentences.zh: 願者，開具一家大小口若干，大口一石，小口減半，五歲以下不預請。

translations.literal: Those willing open a list of household large and small mouths—large mouths one shi, small mouths half; below five years not included in requests.
translations.idiomatic: Willing households listed mouths: adults one shi, children half; under five excluded.

sentences.zh: 甲首加請一倍。

translations.literal: Group heads request an additional double.
translations.idiomatic: Group heads received double.

sentences.zh: 社首審訂虛實，取人人手書持赴本倉，再審無弊，然後排定。

translations.literal: Community heads examine truth and fix; take each person's hand-written statement to this granary, examine again without abuse, then fix the schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Community heads verified lists at the granary.

sentences.zh: 甲首附都簿載某人借若干石，依正簿分兩時給：初當下田時，次當耘耨時。

translations.literal: Group heads attach to district register recording who borrowed how many shi, according to main register giving in two times: first when going down to fields, second at hoeing time.
translations.idiomatic: Grain was issued at planting and hoeing.

translations.idiomatic: Repayment was due by the eighth month thirtieth; bad grain was penalized.)

sentences.zh: 嘉定末，真德秀帥長沙行之，凶年饑歲，人多賴之。

translations.literal: At the end of Jiading, Zhen Dexiu as commander of Changsha implemented it; in famine years many relied on it.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiading's end, Zhen Dexiu implemented this in Changsha; many relied on it in famine.

sentences.zh: 然事久而弊，或移用而無可給，或拘催無異正賦，良法美意，胥此焉失。

translations.literal: Yet after long years there were abuses—some diverted with nothing to give, or collected urgently no different from regular tax—the good law and beautiful intent were all lost here.
translations.idiomatic: Over time funds were diverted or collected like regular tax—the good law was lost.

sentences.zh: 寶慶三年，監察御史汪剛中言：“豐穰之地，穀賤傷農；

translations.literal: In the third year of Baoqing, Supervising Censor Wang Gangzhong said: "In fertile places grain is cheap and farming is harmed;
translations.idiomatic: Baoqing third year, Wang Gangzhong said fertile districts' cheap grain harmed farmers;

sentences.zh: 凶歉之地，濟糴無策。

translations.literal: in famine places, relief sale has no policy.
translations.idiomatic: famine districts lacked relief policy.

sentences.zh: 惟以其所有餘濟其所不足，則饑者不至於貴糴，而農民亦可以得利。

translations.literal: Only using what one has in surplus to succor what is insufficient—then the hungry will not reach expensive relief sale, and farmers also can obtain profit.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus regions should supply deficient ones so the hungry need not buy dear grain and farmers profit.

sentences.zh: 乞申嚴遏糴之禁，凡兩浙、江東西、湖南北州縣有米處，並聽販鬻流通；

translations.literal: We beg to enforce strictly the prohibition on hoarding grain; all prefectures and counties in Liang-Zhe, Jiang East and West, and Hunan North with rice are all permitted to trade and circulate;
translations.idiomatic: Hoarding was to be banned; rice districts in the southeast were to trade freely;

sentences.zh: 違，許被害者越訴，官按劾，吏決配，庶幾令出惟行，不致文具。”

translations.literal: violators—permit victims to appeal across jurisdictions; officials investigate and impeach, clerks sentenced to exile—then perhaps orders will truly be carried out and not remain paper.
translations.idiomatic: violators faced impeachment and clerks exile so orders would be enforced.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark The court followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark Approved.

sentences.zh: 端平元年六月，臣僚奏：“建陽、邵武群盜嘯聚，變起於上戶閉糴。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Duanping, officials memorialized: "Jianyang and Shaowu bandits gather and cry; the change arose from upper households closing grain sales."
translations.idiomatic: Duanping first year, officials said Jianyang and Shaowu banditry arose from hoarding by wealthy households.

sentences.zh: 若專倚兵威以圖殄滅，固無不可；

translations.literal: If relying solely on military power to exterminate, indeed there is nothing impossible;
translations.idiomatic: Military force alone could suppress them;

sentences.zh: 然振救之政一切不講，餞饉所迫，恐人懷等死之心。

translations.literal: yet if relief policies are not discussed at all, pressed by money and hunger, we fear people will harbor equal-death hearts.
translations.idiomatic: but without relief, hunger would drive people to despair.

sentences.zh: 附之者日眾。

translations.literal: Those attaching themselves daily grow numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Followers grew daily.

sentences.zh: 欲望朝廷厲兵選士，湯定已竊發之寇；

translations.literal: We desire the court to sharpen troops and select soldiers, scalding and fixing already erupting bandits;
translations.idiomatic: The court should use troops against active bandits

sentences.zh: 發粟振饑，懷來未從賊者之心，庶人知避害，賊勢自孤，可一舉而滅矣。

translations.literal: release grain to relieve famine, cherishing those not yet following bandits' hearts—then the multitude will know to avoid harm, bandit power will itself be isolated, and they can be extinguished in one stroke.
translations.idiomatic: and release grain to win those not yet rebelled—isolating the bandits for one stroke extermination.

sentences.zh: 此成周荒政散利除盜之說也。”

translations.literal: This is the Zhou dynasty famine policy of dispersing profit and removing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Zhou policy of dispersing profit to remove bandits.

sentences.zh: 八月，以河南州軍新復，令江、淮製置大使司科降米麥一百萬石振濟。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark In the eighth month, because Henan prefectures and armies were newly recovered, the Jiang-Huai Pacification Commission was ordered to allocate one million shi of rice and wheat for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark Eighth month: one million shi of rice and wheat were allocated for newly recovered Henan.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十一年，福建諸郡旱，錫米二十五萬石振糴，一萬石振貧乏細民。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chunxi, Fujian prefectures drought—tin rice two hundred fifty thousand shi for relief sale, ten thousand shi for poor commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi eleventh year: Fujian drought received 250,000 shi for relief sale and 10,000 for the poor.

sentences.zh: 景定元年，臨安府平糴倉舊貯米數十萬石，糶補循環，其後用而不補，所存無幾。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingding, Lin'an fair-sale granary formerly stored several hundred thousand shi of rice, selling and replenishing in cycle; afterward used without replenishing, little remained.
translations.idiomatic: Jingding first year: Lin'an fair-sale granary had once held hundreds of thousands of shi but was depleted without replenishment.

sentences.zh: 有旨令臨安府收糴米四十萬石，用平糴倉錢三百四萬七千八百五十九貫，封樁庫十七界會子一千九十五萬二千一百餘貫，共湊十七界一千四百萬貫，充糴本錢。

translations.literal: An order directed Lin'an to purchase four hundred thousand shi of rice, using fair-sale granary money 3,047,859 strings, sealed-reserve treasury seventeenth-issue notes 10,952,100-odd strings, together making seventeenth-issue 14,000,000 strings as purchase capital.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an was ordered to buy 400,000 shi using fair-sale and sealed-reserve funds totaling 14 million strings in notes.

sentences.zh: 二年，以都城全仰浙西米斛，誘人入京販糶，賞格比乾道七年加優。

translations.literal: In the second year, because the capital wholly relied on Zhe West rice, people were induced to enter the capital to sell grain—reward scales were more favorable than the seventh year of Qiandao.
translations.idiomatic: Second year: the capital relied on Zhe West rice; merchants were induced to sell in the capital with rewards surpassing Qiandao seventh year.
